findings.where: First screen (hero), at both desktop and phone widths, and the whole page below it
findings.fault: The page's one action is missing. There is no way to contact Mark anywhere on the page: no email link, no address shown and no contact panel. The parts map lists only the nav, the logo link, one article link and the replay button. The palette even names a pad-yellow 'address strip' and the texture note talks about a sender's address at the foot of the sheet, but neither was built.
findings.who_objects: A development-bank officer who has read Mark's line and wants to reach him finds no way to do it. The founder also objects, because the brief requires one direct, personal way to reach Mark on the first screen, with the address shown, and the tile cannot pass the personal-advisor test without it.

findings.where: Hero nav (Profile, Articles, Blog) and the article specimen's Download link ('Streamlining the PPP Process…')
findings.fault: The links look live but lead nowhere. Profile, Articles and Blog point to #profile, #articles and #blog, and the page has no sections with those names. The Download link points to '#', so the PDF it offers never opens.
findings.who_objects: Someone who clicks Profile to check Mark's background, or clicks Download to read the lecture, gets nothing and may decide the site is broken. The founder, who judges the hero exactly as a visitor sees it, hits the same dead clicks.

findings.where: Motion sketch, the 'Replay the entrance' control
findings.fault: This is a button that replays the animation where you are, but it is styled as an underlined blue link. That look belongs to links that take you to another place, and here it is used for an action on the spot.
findings.who_objects: A reader expects an underlined blue line to take them somewhere and is surprised when the page stays put. It also blurs the rule that blue underline means 'go somewhere', which is the job the palette gives the blue.

findings.fault: Of the four colour swatches, only this one has a blue outline. It reads as a selected or focused state, the very job the palette gives the blue ('links, focus'), but the swatch can't be clicked.
findings.who_objects: The founder reading the tile may take the yellow as the chosen or highlighted colour, or try to click it. Using the focus look on something you can't use weakens what that look means.
